# Aman

> > Aman is a luxury hospitality brand offering exclusive resorts, hotels, and private residences in premier destinations worldwide, including Amanpuri in Phuket, Aman New York, Amanoi in Vietnam, and Amangiri in Utah.

Aman operates ultra-luxury properties across Asia, the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East, emphasizing wellness, bespoke experiences, and architectural excellence. The brand combines contemporary luxury with cultural immersion, offering spa facilities, fine dining, and exclusive accommodations in iconic locations from tropical beaches to mountain retreats.

## Flagship Resorts & Hotels

- [Luxury Resort & Hotel in Phuket, Thailand - Amanpuri](https://www.aman.com/resorts/amanpuri): Amanpuri luxury beach resort in Phuket, Thailand on Pansea Beach peninsula
- [Luxury Hotel & Beach Resort in Ninh Thuan, Vietnam - Amanoi](https://www.aman.com/resorts/amanoi): Amanoi luxury beach resort in Vinh Hy Bay, Ninh Thuan, Vietnam
- [Hôtel luxe et spa, 5e Avenue, Manhattan - Aman New York](https://www.aman.com/fr-fr/hotels/aman-new-york): Aman New York luxury hotel & spa on Fifth Avenue, Manhattan (French)
- [Resort de luxe en République dominicaine - Amanera](https://www.aman.com/fr-fr/resorts/amanera): Amanera luxury resort overlooking Playa Grande, Dominican Republic (French)
- [Aman Niseko – Hokkaido Wellness Resort Coming Soon, Japan – Aman](https://www.aman.com/resorts/aman-niseko): Aman Niseko luxury ski resort opening soon in Hokkaido, Mount Moiwa, Japan
